instruction_module.description: Non-negotiable behavioral rules for ALL reflow workflows (decision_flow.json, inject_flow.json, etc.)
instruction_module.usage: Load BEFORE every workflow operation - these rules are mandatory

NEVER_GENERATE_REPORTS.description: ABSOLUTE prohibition on generating reports, summaries, or explanatory documents
mandatory_rules: NEVER generate a report after completing a step or substep
NEVER summarize what you just did unless explicitly requested by user
NEVER create 'status update' or 'progress report' documents
NEVER output commentary about the work completed
NEVER create files with names containing: report, summary, status, update, overview
ONLY update tracking files (working_memory.json, step_progress_tracker.json, process_log.md) - no reports
After completing work: UPDATE tracking files, then STOP. No explanation. No summary. No report.
NEVER_GENERATE_REPORTS.exceptions: NONE - this rule has no exceptions
NEVER_GENERATE_REPORTS.enforcement: Pre-operation validation must check agent is not about to create report-like files

MANDATORY_WORKFLOW_ADHERENCE.description: Strict adherence to workflow instructions without deviation
mandatory_rules: READ decision_flow.json OR inject_flow.json AND current workflow step file BEFORE every action
VERIFY current step/substep from step_progress_tracker.json matches workflow instructions
DO NOT proceed with actions that contradict workflow JSON files - even if they seem helpful
DO NOT skip steps or substeps defined in workflow files
DO NOT reinterpret workflow instructions - follow them EXACTLY as written
If workflow says 'do X', you MUST do X. Not Y. Not X plus helpful extras. Just X.
Context does NOT refresh between steps - workflow instructions are ALWAYS active
NEVER assume workflow guidance is 'optional' or 'advisory' - it is MANDATORY
degradation_signals: Taking actions not specified in current workflow step
Adding 'helpful extras' beyond what workflow requires
Asking questions already answered in workflow files

DIRECTORY_STRUCTURE_ENFORCEMENT.description: Maintain clean 4-folder structure at system root level
prohibited_at_root: *.md files (except system README.md if explicitly needed)
Any folders not in allowed_root_folders list
mandatory_rules: NEVER create files in system root directory except in the 4 allowed folders
NEVER create additional folders at system root level
ALL workflow artifacts MUST go in appropriate folder: context/, specs/, services/, or docs/
If unsure where file belongs, put in context/ folder
Run directory validation before and after major operations
DIRECTORY_STRUCTURE_ENFORCEMENT.cleanup_requirement: If prohibited files detected, they MUST be moved to appropriate folder or deleted

SYSTEM_ISOLATION_MANDATORY.description: Critical isolation rules to prevent cross-system contamination
mandatory_rules: ALWAYS verify pwd equals target system's absolute path BEFORE any operation
If pwd is wrong, STOP immediately and navigate to correct system directory
ALL file paths must be relative to current system directory or absolute with verified system path
NEVER reference or modify files in other system directories
NEVER copy files between system directories
Verify system_name in working_memory.json matches current system before proceeding
recovery_procedure: 4. Verify with 'pwd' - output must match target system path
5. Read context/working_memory.json to confirm system_name matches
6. Resume operations only after verification complete

CONTEXT_CONTINUITY.description: Maintain workflow context across all interactions
mandatory_rules: Workflow instructions persist across ALL interactions until workflow completion
You MUST re-read workflow files if you detect yourself violating instructions
step_progress_tracker.json is the ONLY source of truth for current position
working_memory.json contains MANDATORY context that must be consulted before every action
If uncertain about next action: READ tracker files, READ workflow files, THEN act
degradation_recovery: If you feel uncertain about workflow adherence, immediately:
3. READ current workflow file (decision_flow.json or inject_flow.json)
5. CONFIRM next action aligns with workflow requirements

INJECTION_SPECIFIC_RULES.description: Additional rules specific to inject_flow.json workflow
mandatory_rules: NEVER inject reflow tools into a system that already has embedded reflow (check for conflicts first)
ALWAYS backup existing context before injection (safety requirement)
VERIFY injection target has proper 4-folder structure before proceeding
ALL injected files MUST go into context/ subdirectories (workflows/, tools/, templates/, etc.)
NEVER place injected files at system root level
VALIDATE injection success before marking operation complete
DOCUMENT injection in both source reflow and target system process logs
conflict_prevention: Check for existing context/workflows/, context/tools/, context/templates/ before injection
If found, either skip injection (already done) or prompt user for override confirmation
Never silently overwrite existing embedded reflow installation

PRE_OPERATION_VALIDATION.description: MANDATORY checks before every workflow operation
required_steps: 1. CRITICAL_FIRST: Verify pwd equals target system's absolute path
2. CRITICAL_FIRST: If pwd is wrong, execute recovery procedure immediately
3. READ current workflow file (decision_flow.json OR inject_flow.json)
5. VERIFY planned action matches current step requirements
6. VERIFY planned action will NOT generate reports or prohibited files
7. VERIFY operation will maintain 4-folder directory structure
9. Proceed ONLY if all validations pass
PRE_OPERATION_VALIDATION.validation_failure_action: STOP workflow and address validation issues before proceeding

POST_OPERATION_REQUIREMENTS.description: MANDATORY actions after every workflow operation
required_steps: 3. Add entry to context/process_log.md documenting operation
4. Verify system directory structure remains clean (4 folders only)
5. If prohibited files detected, move to appropriate folder or delete
6. STOP - do not generate reports or summaries about the operation

ENFORCEMENT_MECHANISMS.description: How these rules are enforced in workflows
manual_enforcement: Agent must load this file before every workflow operation
User should interrupt if agent begins generating reports
Periodic adherence checks during long workflows
